Speciallärare

Internationella Engelska Skolan söker nu en speciallärare med start december 2026.

Internationella Engelska Skolan i Östersund är en tvåspråkig skola för elever i årskurs F-9. Vår skola erbjuder en trygg och ordnad miljö och vi är fast beslutna att hjälpa varje barn att nå sin fulla potential.

Vi söker en speciallärare med stort engagemang för elevers lärande, hälsa och utveckling. I uppdraget ingår att arbeta för en välfungerande elevhälsa för att stödja elevernas utveckling mot utbildningens mål. 

- De huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifterna är att:

- Kartlägga elevers och gruppers behov

- Arbeta direkt med elev/elever i mindre grupp

- Planera, genomföra och utvärdera insatser

- Delta i skolans systematiska kvalitetsarbete

Kvalifikationer:

Vi söker dig som har svensk lärarlegitimation samt påbyggnadsutbildning till speciallärare eller har erfarenhet inom specialpedagogik. Du har tidigare erfarenhet av arbete med barn och ungdomar. 

Tidigare erfarenhet av arbete som lärare och speciallärare inom grundskolan är meriterande. Mycket god svenska och engelska i tal och skrift är ett krav för tjänsten. 

Arbetet förutsätter att du är trygg i din yrkesroll, kan arbeta självständigt, är initiativrik och har en god förmåga att se möjligheter i olika situationer. Som person har du ett bra bemötande samt en god förmåga att planera och prioritera ditt arbete. Du har en god samarbetsförmåga och intresse av att arbeta tillsammans i team med olika yrkeskategorier. Ditt förhållningssätt är relationellt, och inriktat mot att arbeta hälsofrämjande och förebyggande. Du är flexibel, lyhörd och har lätt för att skapa förtroende och goda relationer till elever, vårdnadshavare och kollegor. Vi lägger stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper.

Intervjuer sker löpande. Skicka in er ansökan med ert CV och personliga brev till recruitment.ostersund@engelska.se.

Modern data platforms are built on events - well-defined, trustworthy signals that describe how users interact with products and systems over time. As a Data Engineer you will help build and improve the data platform that powers analytics, growth, personalization and decision-making across the company.
This role is part of the Data Platform team, where we design and maintain the core data infrastructure that serves Product, Marketing, Growth, and Analytics. You will focus on the systems and infrastructure that supports transforming batch and streaming data into high-quality datasets that downstream systems - from warehouses to activation tools - can rely on.
We are currently in the early stages of building out a new event-driven architecture, and this role will be part of shaping it. That means owning parts of the streaming infrastructure, contributing to foundational decisions about how events are structured and evolved, and having real influence over how data flows across the company for years to come.
This is a hybrid/onsite role located in Stockholm, our guideline is to spend 3 days a week at our office.
What you’ll do
Design and operate data infrastructure (streaming and batch) and the systems that move data reliably at scale.
Contribute to how events are defined, structured, and evolved across the platform.
Ensure data quality, consistency, and observability across event pipelines.
Ensure GDPR and PII compliance across data flows at scale.
Contribute to data and architecture best practices that may span across the whole organisation.

Who you are
A few years of experience as a Data Engineer or data-heavy backend engineer.
Solid programming and data skills (e.g. SQL, Python, and/or JVM-based languages).
Experience building and maintaining data pipelines in a modern cloud data stack.
Experience managing infrastructure as code (e.g. Terraform or similar).
A good understanding of data quality, observability, and reliability.
Clear written communication skills in English and comfort working cross-functionally.
Experience with streaming systems or near real-time data infrastructure (e.g. Kafka, Flink, or similar).

 
📍 Location: 
This is a hybrid/on-site role at Mentimeter HQ in Stockholm, where we expect you to be in the office at least 3 days/week.
Please note that we do not offer relocation sponsorship for the position.  
Not Required:
You don’t have to know Swedish (daily work is carried out in English and the Mentimeter team currently boasts over 50 nationalities!)

Do you want to create technology for the next generation of industry and society? Univrses is now looking for a Deep Learning Engineer to join the team in Stockholm!
Univrses is a 3D Computer Vision and Machine Learning company based in Stockholm, creating high-end technologies for autonomous systems. We work in several different areas, but our primary focus is on self-driving vehicles, mobile robotics and smart city development. Our team consists of hard-working and friendly people from all over the world with diverse backgrounds and expert knowledge in computer vision, robotics, machine learning, physics, math, software development and more.

Your role
As our new Deep Learning Engineer, you will design and implement cutting-edge Computer Vision algorithms and pipelines for advanced perception systems. The work also includes deployment of such solutions, which includes tasks such as testing, deployment configuration and embedded integration, which can require writing C++ code. You will work in close collaboration with scientists and other engineers. Together with your team, you will develop technologies targeted for self-driving vehicles and advanced driver assistance systems that will have a major impact on how people live their lives. You will work in an agile team and collaborate closely with some of the best engineers and scientists in the field.

What you bring
Solid experience with developing clean and production-ready code in Python.

Experience with software testing (unit test, integration test, smoke test etc).

A solid understanding of Deep Learning and Computer Vision.

Experience in developing DL models, analyzing, and deploying them.

Experience working with Agile software development principles.

Experience in DL model deployment optimization (e.g., integration, pruning, quantization).

Familiarity with CI/CD workflow

Masters or equivalent in machine learning, computer science or a related field.

Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work in a collaborative team environment.

Excellent communication and presentation skills in English.

What we offer
Bright and spacious facilities in the heart of Södermalm, Stockholm

Open and friendly work environment

The best co-workers in the world – from all over the world!

Generous employee benefits, such as:

Flexible work hours

5 000 SEK/year in wellness grant

Pension plan

Weekly Lunch and Learns

 Next step
Interested in joining Univrses as our new Deep Learning Engineer? Submit your application today - All application material must be in English!

jobs.occupation: Senior Lecturer in Waste Science and Technology
jobs.description:
Do you want to develop your research and teaching in an environment where collaboration with industry and society is a natural part of the work? With us, you will collaborate with dedicated colleagues, have access to modern research infrastructure, and enjoy strong opportunities to attract external funding. You will have the space to make a real difference for your students, your research, and society at large.
The Department for Civil, Environmental and Natural Resources Engineering at Luleå University of Technology is looking for a Senior Lecturer, who is driven by the interest to strengthen their expertise in advanced environmental technologies, particularly in addressing persistent contaminants such as PFAS, PAH, antibiotics, pesticides.
 
 
This position is intended for advancing ongoing research of the group of Waste Science and Technology in waste management, circular material flows, waste detoxification, and environmental remediation, all of which are essential for driving progress toward a sustainable and environmentally responsible society. The Senior lecturer will contribute to the development of research and education efforts by studying and developing advanced treatment methods and integrated treatment chains for waste, contaminated soils and groundwater.
 
 
This recruitment aligns with the university’s vision to position itself among leaders in environmental technology and establish robust international research collaborations, leveraging unique research and education environment.
 
 
Subject description
 
Waste Science and Technology incorporates all stages of society’s waste management – generation, collection, treatment and disposal of waste, including reuse and recycling, as well as soil and groundwater remediation. The research aims at the development of tools and processes that facilitate sustainable soil remediation and waste management.
 
 
Duties
 
Your duties will mainly consist of research and education. You will lead research projects and supervise Master and PhD students. Teaching and educational development work is included in the tasks, as well as writing and submitting new project proposals for external funding. You will co-author scientific articles to be published in international peer-reviewed journals and present research results at national and international conferences. You are also expected to contribute to the research environment at the Department through participation in meetings, events and cooperation.
 
 
Qualifications 
 
To meet the requirements for the appointment as a senior lecturer, the applicants: 
must have been awarded a doctoral degree in Environmental Engineering, Chemical Engineering or adjacent areas or must have a foreign degree considered equivalent to a doctoral degree.
must demonstrate pedagogical expertise by means of proven experience, teaching expertise and teaching development.
must have completed higher education pedagogy courses equivalent to 7.5 higher education credits or otherwise have acquired equivalent knowledge.

Assessment criteria
 
The following assessment criteria apply to this position:
- scientific expertise
- pedagogical skills
- other assessment criteria
 
 
Other assessment criteria (Ranked in descending order):
- experience in sample preparation and analytical methods for contaminants of emerging concern (CECs) (e.g., PFAS and pharmaceuticals) in soil, waste, and water
- Experience in the development and/or application of advanced degradation technologies for CECs (e.g., electrochemical oxidation, sonolysis, and plasma-based technologies, etc.)
- the ability to obtain external research and development funding
- the ability to teach in Swedish and/or in English
- the ability to communicate research and development work orally and in writing
- the ability to collaborate with the wider community and stakeholders.
 
 
Information
 
The position is a permanent, full-time appointment at Luleå University of Technology.
 
 
For further information about the position, please contact Prof. Jurate Kumpiene, +46 920-493020, mailto:jurate.kumpiene@ltu.se  
 
 
For each position, a preliminary https://www.ltu.se/en/about-the-university/work-with-us/applying-for-a-job#h-Informationonpaytransparency is provided based on the requirements, responsibilities, and market conditions associated with the role.

Join our team as a Senior Data Engineer, where you'll be responsible for designing, building, maintaining, and optimizing data pipelines across our global product portfolio. You'll have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies, embrace AI-assisted development, and explore emerging innovations such as AI agents, agentic workflows, and intelligent automation to shape the future of data engineering at Sinch.
We're seeking someone with a proven background in SQL, Python, and ETL/ELT, who takes a proactive approach to solving complex challenges and building scalable, reliable data solutions. Beyond traditional data engineering, we value an innovative mindset and curiosity about how AI-powered development tools, LLMs, and autonomous agents can improve engineering productivity, automate workflows, and unlock new possibilities across our data platforms.
This role offers a unique opportunity to lead, drive, and implement impactful initiatives in a rapidly growing global business. You'll play an important role in evolving our data architecture, championing modern engineering practices, and exploring how emerging AI technologies can transform the way we build and operate data solutions.
Lead data engineering projects, driving technical decisions and ensuring successful delivery of scalable, high-quality solutions.
Act as a technical authority, supporting leadership and mentoring team members on architecture, engineering practices, and emerging technologies.
Champion engineering excellence through code reviews, automation, AI-assisted development, and continuous improvement.
Promote modern data engineering practices, encouraging innovation and the adoption of new tools and technologies across teams.
Explore opportunities to leverage AI agents, LLMs, and agentic workflows to automate development tasks, streamline data operations, and improve engineering efficiency.
Drive data integration efforts across diverse platforms and products, enabling seamless access to reliable data throughout Sinch.
Contribute to the development, performance, quality, monitoring, and maintenance of data pipelines, ensuring scalability, reliability, and operational excellence.
Identify opportunities to improve our products, business processes, and data architecture through insightful data analysis, intelligent automation, and innovative engineering solutions.

REQUIREMENTS 
We believe you are a professional skilled in pipeline development and governance, with experience in tools for virtualization and a background in real-time data processing. Your organizational prowess is evident in breaking down projects efficiently, and your expertise extends to designing new data architectures with a focus on security standard processes. Your diverse skills make you a valuable asset, poised to drive innovative data solutions for our dynamic team and evolving business. 
Proficient in software development with expertise in Python, Spark, Git, CI/CD, and Docker. 
Experience leveraging AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude, or similar) to accelerate coding, debugging, testing, and documentation while maintaining high standards of code quality, security, and maintainability.
Skilled in using SQL for data querying and ETL/ELT development. 
Strong interest in emerging AI technologies, particularly AI agents and agentic workflows, with a curiosity for exploring how LLMs, autonomous agents, and AI-driven automation can enhance data engineering processes and developer productivity.
Experience in structuring and storing large volumes of data in data lakes and warehouses. 
Capable of fixing and optimizing data pipelines for enhanced performance and reliability. 
Familiarity with data pipeline orchestration tools like Airflow, Dagster, and experience using Databricks.  
Cloud experience in AWS or GCP. 
Knowledgeable about various data architectures such as Data Lake, Data Mesh, and Data Fabric. 
Strong communication skills with fluency in English for engaging with stakeholders from technical and business areas. 

Our corporate language is English, please submit your application in English.
This role is hybrid role based in Stockholm and reporting to the Data Engineering Manager. 
Candidates must have the right to work in Sweden. Relocation and work permit sponsorship are not available for this role.
OUR HIRING PROCESS 
We are committed to ensuring a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and inclusive. Our approach includes structured, competency-based interviews designed to evaluate your skills, experience, and qualifications relevant to the role. At times, we may include a data-driven assessment to enhance our hiring success and identify candidates likely to excel. 
We believe in a two-way process and encourage you to ask questions throughout the journey. If this role isn't what you're looking for, please explore the other opportunities listed on our career page: https://www.sinch.com/careers/. No matter who you are, we hope you find an exciting path forward - hopefully with us!

jobs.occupation: Instructor at UMS Skeldar in Linköping
jobs.description:
Combining research and development with advanced technology, UMS Skeldar provides an advanced helicopter platform for the defence and civil security markets. Together, we create an open culture built on Communication, Trust and Commitment. We enjoy having fun together and know that our team is our greatest asset. With us, you are encouraged to develop, take responsibility and grow in your role.
 Keywords: Instructor, Trainer, RPAS, RP, UAV, UAS, Part-66, Helicopter.
We are now looking for a Technical Instructor with a strong technical interest and a genuine desire to teach and develop others. You will be an important part of building our training team and will have the opportunity to help develop our training activities and take Skeldar’s training to the next level.Instructor at UMS Skeldar:
You will be part of the Support department, which supports our customers and end users throughout the entire product lifecycle. The department works with customer support, training, technical documentation and integrated logistics support (ILS), as well as technical issues related to our systems.
You will be part of the Training team, which is responsible for delivering and continuously developing our courses and training programmes. This includes both classroom-based theory and practical elements in the hangar, simulator or ground station.
To operate our system, two pilots and at least one technician who are authorised on the system are required. As an instructor, you will be responsible for training and examining pilots and/or technicians within our system.
You get a solid introduction to the role and the system through internal training, initially working alongside experienced colleagues. The role mainly involves travel to locations within Sweden, but international travel may also occur.
In the role of Instructor, you will:

Take responsibility for training and instructing users in our system

Deliver training courses both in Sweden and internationally

Plan training sessions and prepare training materials

Further develop our training together with the Training team

Conduct evaluations and follow up on training activities

Conduct training primarily in English

Does the position sound interesting? Don't hesitate to apply today!
Are you the one we are looking for?
We place great emphasis on your personal qualities and are looking for someone who thrives in a role where you can combine technical understanding with meeting and developing others. You have strong collaboration skills, take responsibility for your tasks and drive them forward in a structured way. You are communicative and comfortable adapting and communicating technical information to different target groups. As the work environment is dynamic, we also see that you are flexible and enjoy working with varied tasks.
To succeed in the role, we see that you have experience in an educational role, for example as a UAS instructor, flight instructor or other type of instructor within a technically advanced organisation. It is an advantage if you are a trained flight technician, pilot or have another relevant technical education, as well as experience working with technically complex products or systems. A background as a military instructor or UAV operator, or experience with larger UAV systems, is considered an advantage.
The position requires a good command of English, both spoken and written, as the courses are primarily conducted in English. 
We offer:
• An opportunity to be part of a dynamic company that is constantly evolving, where your contribution can make a real difference
• A high-tech product at the forefront of the market
• A close-knit work culture characterised by collaboration and strong commitment
• Activities that promote both social community and health through our Party Committee, Health Committee, Board Game Committee and Women’s Network 
Inquiries:

Workplace: Linköping

Employment type: Full-time

Start: As soon as possible, taking your notice period into consideration

Travel: Travel is required as part of the role

For employment with UMS Skeldar, you must undergo and be approved in accordance with the regulations for security protection in force at any given time. Roles requiring security classification may, where applicable, entail specific citizenship requirements.
We process applications on an ongoing basis and look forward to receiving your application!

jobs.description:
Science/Math Teacher year 6&8

Would you like to work in an international environment with a clear pedagogical policy?

We are now seeking a qualified and creative science & math  teacher for grades 6 & 8. Please note that we are a school with students from Year F-9. 

About you:You must be knowledgeable and passionate about your subject with a teacher qualification to teach science/math . You are a leader in the classroom with the tools to create a calm learning environment. You differentiate your teaching to meet the needs of all your students. Continuous formative feedback to students ensures the students steady development and is a natural part of your teaching.

jobs.description:
Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) is a leading independent school group ("friskola") with academic results far above average and a diverse and energetic staff. Teaching is through both Swedish and English, with English the language of the corridors. IES is one of Sweden's largest school groups at "Grundskolan" with 43 schools and around 30,000 students across the country. IES has grown steadily and maintained quality since 1993. IES Eskilstuna is one of the largest schools in Sweden with 1,185 students enrolled in grades F-9 and approx 125 staff members.
Vill du arbeta med barn och unga och göra skillnad i deras vardag? IES Eskilstuna söker engagerade och ansvarstagande timvikarier till vår grundskola för årskurs 4-9.Som timvikarie hos oss får du ett varierande och meningsfullt arbete där du stöttar verksamheten vid ordinarie personals frånvaro. Du möter elever i olika åldrar och blir en viktig del av skolans trygga och positiva lärmiljö.
Arbetsuppgifter:

Vikariera för lärare vid frånvaro

Ansvara för undervisning utifrån planering från ordinarie personal

Skapa trygghet, struktur och studiero i klassrummet

Bidra till en trygg och stimulerande lärmiljö under lektioner och raster

Samarbeta med kollegor

Vara behjälplig vid inom- och utomhusaktiviteter

Detta är en fantastisk möjlighet att få erfarenhet av att arbeta i en tvåspråkig miljö och utvecklas inom skolans värld! 
KVALIFIKATIONERVi söker dig som är flexibel och kan hoppa in som timvikarie med kort varsel. Du har avslutad gymnasieutbildning och erfarenhet av att arbeta med barn och ungdomar. Det är meriterande om du tidigare arbetat på skola eller grundskola, studerar till fritidsledare/lärare i fritidshemmet eller har relevant utbildning inom området. 
Som person är du ansvarsfull och tycker om att ta egna initiativ. Du har ett tydligt elevfokus. Arbetet som timvikarie består av många möten och det är därför av stor vikt att du har en positiv människosyn och en god samarbetsförmåga. Framförallt har du ett brinnande intresse för barn och ungdomars lärande och utveckling.
Vi söker dig som:

Brinner för att arbeta med barn och ungdomar

Är trygg, flexibel och ansvarstagande

Har ett positivt bemötande och god samarbetsförmåga

Kan leda grupper och skapa god ordning

Kan skapa goda relationer med våra elever, personal och vårdnadshavare

Kan bidra till arbetsro i elevgrupp och i klassrummet

Har goda kunskaper i svenska och/eller engelska, både i tal och skrift

Anställningsformen är timanställning vid behov, med start så snart som möjligt.
För att arbeta hos oss krävs att du ska ha fyllt 18 år och du behöver ett utdrag ur belastningsregistret, ansök via länken.https://polisen.se/tjanster-tillstand/belastningsregistret/skola-eller-forskola/ 
Stor vikt läggs vid personlig lämplighet.
Vi tar inte emot ansökningar via email.
Välkommen med din ansökan!

CLEANING SUPERVISOR – HOSTEL
Stockholm, Sweden
We are looking for a hands-on Cleaning Supervisor to join our growing hostel group in central Stockholm. This role is ideal for someone with strong cleaning experience who is organized, responsible and enjoys working with people in an international environment.
Who we are looking for
Previous experience in professional cleaning and preferably as a cleaning supervisor or team leader.

Strong cleaning skills and a good understanding of cleanliness and hygiene standards.

Able to communicate confidently in English, both spoken and written.

Responsible, organized and attentive to detail.

Comfortable supervising and coordinating a small team.

Positive, practical and willing to take initiative.

EU citizenship or permanent residency/work authorization in an EU country.

Experience in hospitality, hostels or hotels is a plus, as is education within hospitality or service.

You do not need extensive hospitality or management experience to be considered. If you have strong cleaning experience, the right attitude and are willing to learn, we are happy to train you in the other parts of the role.
The role
As Cleaning Supervisor, you will both work hands-on with cleaning and supervise a small team. Your responsibilities include:
Cleaning guest rooms, bathrooms and common areas.

Supervising and coordinating the cleaning team.

Checking rooms and common areas to ensure our cleanliness standards are maintained.

Planning and distributing daily cleaning tasks.

Keeping track of cleaning supplies, linen and other necessities.

Helping with hostel reception and guest-related tasks when needed.

Reporting maintenance issues and helping solve practical day-to-day problems.

Communicating with the hostel management, online reception and remote team.

The position is approximately 40–50 hours per week, working in shifts during the hostel’s operating hours, with 1–2 days off per week. You will have flexibility to organize your schedule according to the needs of the property.
About us
We are a growing hospitality company currently operating three hostels in central Stockholm. Our goal is to build an international hostel group based around our Scandinavian Nomad design concept.
Our organization combines on-site teams with an online team and online reception. For the right person, there are opportunities to grow within the company and take on more responsibility over time.
What we offer
Salary: 27,000 SEK/month gross
Relocation: Flight to Stockholm included
Accommodation: Affordable staff accommodation available at the hostel
Vacation: One month paid vacation per year
You will work in a friendly, international environment, meet people from around the world and have the opportunity to develop your English, hospitality and leadership skills while experiencing life in Stockholm.
